categories.name: General Math
categories.description: Test your knowledge of mathematics concepts and problems.

questions.question: What is the value of π (pi) to two decimal places?
questions.explanation: Pi (π) is approximately equal to 3.14159..., which is 3.14 when rounded to two decimal places.

questions.question: What is the square root of 144?
questions.explanation: 12 × 12 = 144, so the square root of 144 is 12.

questions.question: If a triangle has angles of 60°, 60°, and 60°, what type of triangle is it?
questions.explanation: A triangle with all angles equal (60°) is an equilateral triangle.

categories.name: Science
categories.description: Explore questions about physics, chemistry, biology and more.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.explanation: Au (from Latin 'aurum') is the chemical symbol for gold.

questions.question: What is the hardest natural substance on Earth?
questions.explanation: Diamond is the hardest known natural material on Earth.

questions.question: Which planet has the most moons?
questions.explanation: Saturn has the most moons with 82 confirmed moons.

questions.question: What is the main component of the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of Earth's atmosphere.

questions.question: What is the speed of light in a vacuum?
questions.explanation: The speed of light in a vacuum is approximately 300,000 kilometers per second.
